title: andeimalva chilensis
intro: Andeimalva chilensis, commonly known as Chilean Malva, is a flowering plant species of the Malvaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. Andeimalva chilensis has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
